• Windows: offline Whisper speech subtitle alignment. First tap asks to download a verified 148 MB English model. No microphone or cloud speech recognition.
• iOS: remembers Apple online Speech consent after Allow; revoke in Settings.
• Both: recheck external text subtitles every 5 minutes while playing, skipping paused/busy playback and never prompting during background checks.
• At least two matching dialogue cues required; DRM/live/unsupported sources may not sync.
